plan.notes: Source: official University of Miami Bulletin (bulletin.miami.edu) page 'B.S. in Computer Science', URL https://bulletin.miami.edu/undergraduate-academic-programs/arts-sciences/computer-science/computer-science-bs-students-arts-sciences/, 'Suggested Plan of Study' grid. Catalog year: 2026-2027 (current live bulletin; page HTML footer references 2026-2027, and the newest archive edition is 2024-2025). Transcription method: manual read of the live HTML plan grid on 2026-09-30; course codes, titles, and credit hours copied verbatim. TOTAL DISCLOSURE: the plan grid itself publishes 'Total Credit Hours 121' and the degree's Curriculum Requirements section also lists 121; total_credits is set to 121 (the sequence/catalog's own published total). Blanks in the plan grid are decoded as student-choice slots (choice:true): the 4+1 rows in Years 2 Fall/Spring are the Natural Science lecture + associated lab from the plan's Science requirement (options per catalog: BIL 150/151 + BIL 160/161, CHM 121/113 + CHM 221/205, PHY 201/106 + PHY 202/108, PHY 221 + PHY 222/224 + PHY 223/225, or GSC 110/111); all other 3-credit blanks are UM general-education cognates (Arts & Humanities / People & Society) or electives, which the bulletin leaves unspecified. Prereqs are intentionally left empty: the bulletin plan grid publishes no prerequisite column and prereqs were not transcribed from individual course pages; term order follows the official sequence. Credit check: 17+17+14+14+16+15+13+15 = 121. 8 semesters. This is the University of Miami, Coral Gables FL -- not Miami University (Ohio).
